name: herdr-brain
description: Herdr Monitor: a durable record of work items, runs, reports and zero-inference status outside any LLM session.

scripts.test:fast: node test/helpers/run.mjs test/report.test.mjs test/discernment.test.mjs test/sanitization.test.mjs brain/test/capture.test.mjs console/test/model.test.mjs console/test/modern.test.mjs console/test/frame.test.mjs console/test/paint.test.mjs console/test/names.test.mjs console/test/waiting.test.mjs console/proto/prototype.test.mjs lanes/test/routes.test.mjs lanes/test/validation.test.mjs
scripts.test:promotion: node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion -- npm run test:promotion:steps
scripts.test: npm run test:slot && npm run test:core && npm run test:cycle
scripts.test:core: node test/helpers/suite.mjs --file-timeout=480000 --suite-timeout=540000 test/*.mjs test/fixtures/*.mjs brain/test/*.test.mjs console/test/*.test.mjs console/test/fixtures/*.mjs console/proto/*.test.mjs watch/test/*.test.mjs dispatch/test/*.test.mjs housekeeping/test/*.test.mjs discovery/test/*.test.mjs promote/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:promotion:steps: npm run test:slot && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:core --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:core && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:cycle --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:cycle && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:lanes --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:lanes && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:acceptance --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:acceptance
